description: This file defines functions, types, and constants for managing Git branches, including creating, deleting, moving, and querying branches within a Git repository.

methods.name: git_branch_create
methods.description: Creates a new branch pointing at a target commit, with options to force overwrite.

methods.name: git_branch_create_from_annotated
methods.description: Creates a new branch from an annotated commit, allowing for precise reflog messages.

methods.name: git_branch_iterator_new
methods.description: Creates an iterator to loop over branches in a repository.

methods.name: git_branch_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next branch from an iterator.

methods.name: git_branch_move
methods.description: Moves or renames an existing local branch reference.

methods.name: git_branch_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a branch by name in a repository.

methods.name: git_branch_name
methods.description: Returns the name of a given branch reference.

methods.name: git_branch_upstream
methods.description: Retrieves the upstream remote-tracking branch for a local branch.

methods.name: git_branch_set_upstream
methods.description: Sets the upstream configuration for a local branch.

methods.name: git_branch_upstream_name
methods.description: Gets the name of the upstream remote-tracking branch.

methods.name: git_branch_is_head
methods.description: Checks if the branch is currently pointed to by HEAD.

methods.name: git_branch_remote_name
methods.description: Gets the name of the remote for a remote-tracking branch.

methods.name: git_branch_upstream_remote
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the upstream remote for a local branch.
